role: Finite authored geometry and unchanged-default-world placement witnesses; native screenshots/review are separate

openings.scope: finite centerline/port/pore/aperture witnesses on authored geometry only; no fluid connectivity simulation or body grip

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

meadowClusters.scope: finite current sitePlan cluster circular XZ envelopes (.48 cluster + .018 animation rounded to .52), not all geometry or all frames

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against full projected rectangle, including crossing and endpoint/corner distances

waterBacking.scope: actual wet backing under dry land, no water physics

placement.limits: one unchanged default-world off-road authored placement,five base-support rays,finite footprint walkability,actual road triangles and conservative full-card envelopes; no owner-world placement, anatomical fit or all-camera visibility guarantee
